# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After ATR-based volatility compression, a breakout above opening range high with expanding volume indicates institutional participation and follow-through momentum. This edge exists because low volatility periods often precede informed trading, and volume-confirmed breakouts signal absorption of liquidity and directional commitment from smart money.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: ATR(5) < 0.6 * ATR(20) for 3 consecutive 1-minute candles (volatility compression), then price closes above opening range high (ORH) with volume > 1.8 * average volume of prior 20 candles, and EMA(9) > EMA(20) > EMA(50) (bullish ribbon alignment). Exit shape: Initial stop at OR low (ORL) or 0.5*ATR below entry (whichever is closer), profit target at 2:1 reward-risk, then trail remaining position with chandelier exit (3x ATR) from high-water mark. Regime hint: VIX < 22 (low volatility environment), time between 9:45-10:30 AM ET to avoid opening chaos and lunch chop, avoids high-impact news windows.
